basics.name: Alex Rivers
basics.label: Senior Data Analyst
basics.summary: Strategic and results-driven Senior Data Analyst with over 6 years of experience in translating complex datasets into actionable business insights at Google and Microsoft. Expert in statistical modeling, data visualization, and predictive analytics. Proven ability to optimize data architecture and drive multi-million dollar revenue growth through data-backed decision making.
basics.objective: To leverage advanced analytical skills and enterprise-level experience to drive data-driven innovation and operational excellence in a lead analyst role.

work.name: Google
work.summary:
• Lead the Google Cloud data insights team, overseeing analysis for a 200M+ user segment.
  • Developed a churn prediction model using Python and BigQuery that accurately reduced user attrition by 18% in the first year.

work.name: Microsoft
work.summary:
• Analyzed telemetry data for Microsoft 365, identifying critical performance bottlenecks that led to a 12% improvement in app load times.
  • Engineered unified data dashboards in Power BI for executive leadership, consolidating metrics from 12+ separate global regions.
  • Reduced data processing costs by 25% by optimizing complex T-SQL queries and redesigning star-schema databases.
  • Partnered with UX teams to perform deep-dive analysis on user friction points, directly influencing 3 major product updates.

  • Kaggle: Ranked in top 1% of global analysts in predictive finance competitions.
  • Speaker: Regular presenter at Bay Area Data Science summits on Cloud Analytics.
